description: ConTeXt LMTX typesetting system based on LuaMetaTeX
notes: ConTeXt LMTX is a rolling release: the first install downloads the full
ConTeXt tree (a few hundred MB) and generates formats, so it can take a while.
Run 'scoop update context' to pick up newer builds when the upstream date changes.
post_install: # The patch content below is duplicated from bucket/patches/context-lmtx-mtxrun-unzipdir.patch
# (the canonical, reviewable copy of this same diff) instead of being read from that file, because
# a manifest hook script has no reliable way to locate its own bucket checkout at install time: the
# local path depends on the alias the user chose with 'scoop bucket add', on any $env:SCOOP override,
# and on whether the install is per-user or --global. Keeping post_install fully self-contained avoids
# depending on any of that. If you change the fix, update both copies and re-verify they stay identical.
-     if not validate or validate(n) then
+     elseif not validate or validate(n) then

Write-Host 'Applied bucket/patches/context-lmtx-mtxrun-unzipdir.patch to bin\mtxrun.lua: works around an upstream mtx-install.lua bug where unzipdir writes zip directory-marker entries as 0-byte files, which then blocks mkdir for the real files that belong inside. Reported to ntg-context@ntg.nl.'
Write-Host 'git apply failed (upstream bin\mtxrun.lua changed since this patch was written?); relying on the post-hoc retry below if the bootstrap fails'
Write-Host 'contextcnf.lua missing after first bootstrap pass.'

Write-Host 'Working around a known mtx-install.lua bug: its zip fast-path (util-zip.lua unzipdir) treats zip directory-marker entries as content (unzipfile returns "" for them, which is truthy in Lua) and writes them as 0-byte files, e.g. tex\texmf-context\web2c, which then blocks mkdir for the real files that belong inside.'

Write-Host 'mtx-install.lua always saves tex\texmf.tma / tex\texmf-context.tma after the pass regardless of write success, so a second run takes the per-file diff/update path instead of the buggy zip fast-path, once the 0-byte blockers are removed.'
Write-Host '--- diagnostics: tex tree after bootstrap ---'
if (Test-Path $texPath) { Get-ChildItem $texPath | Format-Table Name, Mode | Out-String | Write-Host } else { Write-Host 'tex\ does not exist' }

throw "ConTeXt LMTX bootstrap failed (exit code $bootstrap_exit): context.exe/mtxrun.exe missing/empty, or tex\texmf-context tree not installed (contextcnf.lua missing) even after retry. Try 'scoop uninstall context' then 'scoop install context' again."
